description: A right expander for BZ-MAPPER, going immediately to the right of it, which puts a CV input on the horizontal and vertical position of every node and control point of the Bezier curve

inputs.text: A voltage setting the horizontal position of that node of the curve
A voltage setting the horizontal position of that control point of the curve
A voltage setting the vertical position of that node of the curve
A voltage setting the vertical position of that control point of the curve

notes: the panel carries a row for NODE 1 to NODE 6 and for CTRL-P 1 to CTRL-P 5, and only the rows the curve currently has are read
the number of nodes the curve has is set by the NODES buttons on BZ-MAPPER, from 2 to 6
BZ-ENVELOPE takes this expander in the same way as BZ-MAPPER.
a BZ-XPANDXPAND placed immediately to the right of this module adds a scale and an offset to each of these inputs.
